purpose: Post-hoc exploratory smaller teacher weight after 0.5 distillation underperformed the matched supervised control

pruning.method: downstream pointwise input-channel L1 weight magnitude
pruning.reason: Simple existing rule; earlier 445-image tuning comparison showed this width close to baseline. This is an informed exploratory choice, not a blinded selection.

comparison: Same starting checkpoint, seed, epoch and data order as the 0.5 and supervised runs. Tuning already inspected; no blind claim.
limitations: Post-hoc teacher weight; one seed and one epoch; pretraining overlap unknown; no Orin result.
